rule: Long next-open after close>MA; ATR(14) k=2.5 hard stop capped at 2x12% floor; MA trailing exit; no TP; 1% risk/trade.

methodology.headline: OOS (walk-forward median across 5 folds + worst fold). Single 60/40 OOS is secondary. Most-recent 10% is a never-touched holdout.
methodology.slippage: net of 5bps liquid / 15bps illiquid per leg
methodology.survivorship: UNIVERSE is current-listed only -> survivorship-biased; pf_oos_survivorship_adj injects 5% synthetic total-loss trades. LIVE RESULTS WILL BE LOWER.
methodology.multiple_comparisons: 8 variants x 6 classes; expected ~1.0 golden by chance under no-edge null.
methodology.out_of_scope: market impact, order-type, latency not modeled (daily-bar paper tracker). NFA.
